title: Tech View and Board View offer a Technician filter that List does not
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 px wide, so the display switcher (List, Tech View, Board View) shows at the right of the Work Orders toolbar.
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example Ana Carter) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.
  • Technician {Technician-B} (for example Ana Brooks) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User, was added after {Technician-A}, has the same first name as {Technician-A} and a last name that comes before {Technician-A}'s in the alphabet.
  • Technician {Technician-C} (for example Ben Adams) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User, was added after {Technician-B}, has a first name that comes after theirs and a last name that comes before both of theirs.
  • Approved work order {Work-order-1} (for example S10043-17621) for customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST NT1 Technician Filter List") is led by {Technician-A}.
  • On the Work Orders page nothing is chosen in any filter, Assigned to me is off and Search is empty.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders and click the All tab.
  2. Click Tech View in the display switcher.
  3. Write down the technician group headers shown, from top to bottom.
  4. Read the filters in the filter bar, from left to right.
  5. Click the Technician filter.
  6. Read the options in its list, from top to bottom.
  7. Tick {Technician-A}.
  8. Tick {Technician-B} (open the Technician filter again first if the list closed).
  9. Read the Technician filter.
  10. Click Board View in the display switcher.
  11. Read the filters in the filter bar, from left to right.
  12. Click the Technician filter and read the options in its list, from top to bottom.
  13. Click List in the display switcher.
  14. Read the filters in the filter bar.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: Tech View's filter bar shows a Technician filter after Assigned to me (to its right). It shows no Department filter, and no Customer or Service Advisor filter.
  • Step 6: the list starts with Unassigned, then lists the location's technicians by first name, then last name: {Technician-B} comes before {Technician-A} (same first name, earlier last name), and both come before {Technician-C} (later first name), although {Technician-C} has the earliest last name and {Technician-B} was added after {Technician-A}.
  • Steps 3 and 6: the technicians in the list are the same people who have a group in Tech View.
  • Steps 7 to 9: {Technician-A} and {Technician-B} are both chosen at the same time.
  • Steps 11 and 12: Board View's filter bar shows the same Technician filter after Assigned to me (to its right), with the same options in the same order, and no Department, Customer or Service Advisor filter.
  • Step 14: List's filter bar shows no Technician filter.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 52 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S1-R15 and S1-R15b, the Feature Overview's new exceptions sentence, and the Out of Scope additions (Department filter; retired Customer and Service Advisor chips) (added in version 52 on 14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward ruling after Sasha Grosman's staging review follow-up), read 14 Oct 2026. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R15: “In Tech View and Board View the filter bar also offers a Technician filter, after Assigned to me. It is a multi-select listing Unassigned first, then the location’s technicians (the same people who get a group or column, S9-R4), by first name then last name. Choosing one or more shows only those technicians’ groups or columns; every other group or column, pinned ones included, is hidden. It filters by lead technician only.”
  • Feature Overview (the two exceptions): “Imported work orders are one exception: they open in List only (S1-R13a, S1-R13b). The Technician filter is the other: Tech View and Board View offer it and List does not (S1-R15).”
  • Out of Scope: “A Department filter. The design shows one, but a work order’s department is not shown or editable on any work order screen today, so users could not see why a work order matches. Revisit once the work order shows its department.”
  • Out of Scope: “The Customer and Service Advisor filter chips production retired in the redesign (SV-8785) are not brought back.”
  • S1-R15b: “List does not offer the Technician filter and stays as in production. Switching to List while technicians are chosen shows List as if none were chosen; switching back to Tech View or Board View brings the choice back. The choice is remembered the same way as the other filters.”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - not yet build-verified on the Work Orders QA build
